+                 "generated_member_digest")
+        _require(type(identity) is dict and set(identity) == {"final_path", "volume_serial", "file_id", "size", "links", "directory"},
+                 "complete_file_identity")
+        final_path = identity["final_path"]
+        # GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(flags=0) returns this fixed extended DOS
+        # spelling. Compare lexically; never follow a path supplied by a frame.
+        _require(type(final_path) is str and len(final_path) <= 4096
+                 and final_path.casefold() == ("\\\\?\\" + paths[index]).casefold(), "fixed_generated_final_path")
+        _require(type(identity["volume_serial"]) is int and 0 <= identity["volume_serial"] < 1 << 64,
+                 "volume_serial_bound")
+        file_id = identity["file_id"]
+        _require(type(file_id) is str and len(file_id) == 32 and all(char in "0123456789abcdef" for char in file_id),
+                 "file_id_shape")
+        _require(type(identity["size"]) is int and identity["size"] == len(GENERATED[name])
+                 and type(identity["links"]) is int and identity["links"] == 1
+                 and identity["directory"] is False, "generated_file_shape")
+        expected = FileIdentity(final_path, identity["volume_serial"], bytes.fromhex(file_id),
+                                identity["size"], 1, False)
+        validated.append((name, value, expected, row["sha256"]))
+    _require(type(expected_manifest_sha256) is str and len(expected_manifest_sha256) == 64
+             and manifest_digest(payload) == expected_manifest_sha256, "authenticated_manifest_binding")
+    return tuple(validated)
+

+class InheritedReadSetAdoption:
+    """One worker-local operation, owned by the fixed serial child flow.
+
+    Refused owners are kept until that child exits. No arbitrary recovery or
+    real namespace capability can be obtained by toggling a field here.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, primitives):
+        self.primitives = primitives
+        self.read_set = None
+        self.assets = None
+        self.namespace = None
+        self.inheritance_cleared = 0
+        self.identities_checked = 0
+        self.observed_identities = []
+        self.materialization_started = False
+        self.status = "new"
+
+    def adopt(self, authenticated_payload, root, case, control_value, manifest_sha256):
+        _require(self.status == "new" and self.read_set is None, "single_adoption_attempt")
+        self.status = "validating"
+        try:
+            rows = validate_manifest(authenticated_payload, root, case, control_value, manifest_sha256)
+            _require(not any(not handle.closed and handle.value in {row[1] for row in rows}
+                             for handle in self.primitives.handles), "inherited_handle_already_owned")
+            read_set = ReadSet()
+            self.read_set = read_set
+            self.primitives.read_sets.append(read_set)
+            # All partial owners precede inheritance and identity queries. The
+            # control endpoint is already separately owned, and cannot overlap.
+            for name, value, expected, digest in rows:
+                read_set.members.append(self.primitives._retain(value, "adopted-generated-member"))
+            ffi = self.primitives.api.ffi
+            for handle in read_set.members:
+                flags = ffi.c_uint32()
+                self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
+                _require(flags.value == 1, "exact_inherited_handle_flag_required")
+                self.primitives.api.checked("SetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), 1, 0)
+                self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
+                _require(flags.value == 0, "inherited_flag_not_cleared")
+                self.inheritance_cleared += 1
+            for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, rows):
+                actual = self.primitives.identity(handle)
+                self.identities_checked += 1
+                self.observed_identities.append(_identity_row(actual))
+                _require(actual == row[2], "inherited_file_identity_mismatch")
+                read_set.identities.append(actual)
+            self.assets = tuple(BufferAsset(row[0], row[2].size, row[3], handle)
+                                for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, rows))
+            self.status = "adopted"
+            return self
+        except BaseException:
+            self.status = "refused"
+            if self.read_set is not None:
+                self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
+            raise
+
+    def materialize_generated(self):
+        _require(self.status == "adopted" and not self.materialization_started, "adoption_before_readback")
+        self.materialization_started = True
+        try:
+            self.namespace = PinnedBufferNamespace(self.primitives, self.read_set, self.assets, PAYLOAD_BYTES).materialize()
+            _require(self.namespace.namespace_sha256 == namespace_digest(), "complete_generated_namespace_digest")
+            for name in NAMES:
+                _require(self.namespace.lookup(name) == GENERATED[name], "generated_complete_byte_readback")
+            self.status = "materialized"
+            return {"namespace_sha256": namespace_digest(), "payload_bytes": PAYLOAD_BYTES,
+                    "members": [{"name": name, "bytes": len(GENERATED[name]),
+                                 "sha256": hashlib.sha256(GENERATED[name]).hexdigest()} for name in NAMES]}
+        except BaseException:
+            self.status = "refused"
+            self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
+            raise
+
+    def release_after_reads(self):
+        _require(self.status == "materialized" and self.read_set is not None and not self.read_set.unconfirmed,
+                 "only_successful_readback_can_release")
+        # No worker belongs to this child-local set and all synchronous reads
+        # have returned. The parent guards remain held through actual exit.
+        result = self.primitives.release_read_set(self.read_set)
+        _require(result is True and self.read_set.released, "child_read_guard_release_unconfirmed")
+        self.status = "released"
+        return True
+
+    def receipt(self):
+        return {"status": self.status, "owned_members": len(self.read_set.members) if self.read_set else 0,
+                "inheritance_cleared": self.inheritance_cleared, "identities_checked": self.identities_checked,
+                "observed_identities": list(self.observed_identities),
+                "materialization_started": self.materialization_started,
+                "read_set_unconfirmed": self.read_set.unconfirmed if self.read_set else None,
+                "read_set_released": self.read_set.released if self.read_set else False,
+                "handles_closed": [handle.closed for handle in self.read_set.members] if self.read_set else [],
+                "complete_native_namespace_protection": False, "model_calls": 0}
+
+
+def controller_admitted_envelope(startup, primitives, read_set, worker, choice, usage, generation, child_source_sha256):
+    """Construct an authenticated admitted-selection envelope carrying exact retained bindings."""
+    _require(choice in MODEL_MEMBERS, "unsupported_admitted_choice")
+    expected_members = MODEL_MEMBERS[choice]
+    _require(len(read_set.members) == len(read_set.identities) == len(worker.child_read_handles) == len(expected_members),
+             "exact_admitted_readset_membership")
+    _require(startup.selected.choice == choice, "startup_choice_mismatch")
+    assets_by_name = {asset.name: asset for asset in startup.selected.assets}
+    _require(set(assets_by_name) == set(expected_members), "startup_assets_mismatch_model_spec")
+    rows = []
+    for index, name in enumerate(expected_members):
+        handle = read_set.members[index]
+        expected_identity = read_set.identities[index]
+        primitives._owned(handle)
+        _require(primitives.identity(handle) == expected_identity, "parent_guard_identity_changed")
+        asset = assets_by_name[name]
+        row = {
+            "name": name,
+            "handle": worker.child_read_handles[index],
+            "size": asset.size,
+            "sha256": asset.sha256,
+            "identity": _identity_row(expected_identity),
+        }
+        rows.append(row)
+    snapshot_identity = _identity_row(startup.admission.directory_identity)
+    payload = {
+        "schema": ADMITTED_FORMAT,
+        "release_manifest_sha256": startup.release.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256,
+        "selection": {
+            "choice": choice,
+            "repository": startup.selected.repo,
+            "revision": startup.selected.revision,
+        },
+        "members": rows,
+        "profile": {
+            "profile_id": startup.policy.profile_id,
+            "device": startup.policy.device,
+            "compute_type": startup.policy.compute_type,
+            "whisperx_fixed_vad_contract": startup.policy.whisperx_fixed_vad_contract,
+            "capture_vad_contract": startup.policy.capture_vad_contract,
+            "usage": usage,
+        },
+        "snapshot": {
+            "snapshot_path": startup.admission.snapshot,
+            "directory_identity": snapshot_identity,
+        },
+        "channel_binding": {
+            "generation_hex": generation,
+            "child_source_sha256": child_source_sha256,
+            "process_creation_time": worker.creation_time,
+        },
+    }
+    envelope_sha = admitted_envelope_digest(payload)
+    _require(envelope_sha != startup.release.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256,
+             "envelope_digest_must_differ_from_manifest_digest")
+    validate_admitted_envelope(payload, choice, worker.child_control_handle, envelope_sha)
+    return payload
+
+
+def validate_admitted_envelope(payload, choice, control_value, expected_envelope_sha256, channel_binding=None):
+    """Validate authenticated admitted envelope shape, membership, handles and identities."""
+    _require(type(payload) is dict and set(payload) == {
+        "schema", "release_manifest_sha256", "selection", "members", "profile", "snapshot", "channel_binding"
+    }, "admitted_envelope_shape")
+    _require(payload["schema"] == ADMITTED_FORMAT, "admitted_envelope_schema")
+    _require(type(expected_envelope_sha256) is str and len(expected_envelope_sha256) == 64
+             and admitted_envelope_digest(payload) == expected_envelope_sha256,
+             "authenticated_admitted_envelope_binding")
+    _require(payload["release_manifest_sha256"] != expected_envelope_sha256,
+             "envelope_digest_must_differ_from_manifest_digest")
+    _require(type(choice) is str and choice in MODEL_MEMBERS, "unsupported_admitted_choice")
+    selection = payload["selection"]
+    _require(type(selection) is dict and set(selection) == {"choice", "repository", "revision"}
+             and selection["choice"] == choice, "admitted_selection_mismatch")
+    expected_members = MODEL_MEMBERS[choice]
+    rows = payload["members"]
+    _require(type(rows) is list and len(rows) == len(expected_members),
+             "admitted_envelope_member_count_mismatch")
+    _require(type(control_value) is int and 0 < control_value < (1 << 64) - 1, "fixed_control_handle")
+    seen_handles = set()
+    seen_identities = set()
+    validated = []
+    for index, expected_name in enumerate(expected_members):
+        row = rows[index]
+        _require(type(row) is dict and set(row) == {"name", "handle", "size", "sha256", "identity"}, "member_shape")
+        name, handle_val, size, sha256_val, ident = (
+            row["name"], row["handle"], row["size"], row["sha256"], row["identity"]
+        )
+        _require(name == expected_name, "member_order_and_name_mismatch")
+        _require(type(handle_val) is int and 0 < handle_val < (1 << 64) - 1 and handle_val != control_value,
+                 "invalid_inherited_member_handle")
+        _require(handle_val not in seen_handles, "aliased_inherited_member_handles_refused")
+        seen_handles.add(handle_val)
+        _require(type(size) is int and size > 0, "positive_asset_size_required")
+        _require(type(sha256_val) is str and len(sha256_val) == 64 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in sha256_val),
+                 "asset_sha256_format")
+        _require(type(ident) is dict and set(ident) == {"final_path", "volume_serial", "file_id", "size", "links", "directory"},
+                 "complete_file_identity_shape")
+        _require(ident["size"] == size and ident["links"] == 1 and ident["directory"] is False, "member_file_shape")
+        file_key = (ident["volume_serial"], ident["file_id"])
+        _require(file_key not in seen_identities, "aliased_physical_member_identities_refused")
+        seen_identities.add(file_key)
+        file_id_bytes = bytes.fromhex(ident["file_id"]) if isinstance(ident["file_id"], str) else ident["file_id"]
+        expected_fid = FileIdentity(ident["final_path"], ident["volume_serial"], file_id_bytes,
+                                    ident["size"], ident["links"], ident["directory"])
+        validated.append({"name": name, "handle": handle_val, "size": size, "sha256": sha256_val, "identity": expected_fid})
+    profile = payload["profile"]
+    _require(type(profile) is dict and set(profile) == {
+        "profile_id", "device", "compute_type", "whisperx_fixed_vad_contract", "capture_vad_contract", "usage"
+    }, "admitted_profile_shape")
+    _require(profile["device"] == "cpu" and profile["compute_type"] in ("int8", "float32"), "qualified_cpu_profile_required")
+    snapshot = payload["snapshot"]
+    _require(type(snapshot) is dict and set(snapshot) == {"snapshot_path", "directory_identity"}, "admitted_snapshot_shape")
+    if channel_binding is not None:
+        cb = payload["channel_binding"]
+        _require(type(cb) is dict and set(cb) == {"generation_hex", "child_source_sha256", "process_creation_time"},
+                 "admitted_channel_binding_shape")
+        _require(cb["generation_hex"] == channel_binding.generation_hex
+                 and cb["child_source_sha256"] == channel_binding.bootstrap_source_sha256
+                 and cb["process_creation_time"] == channel_binding.process_creation_time,
+                 "admitted_channel_binding_mismatch")
+    return tuple(validated)
+

+class AdmittedReadSetAdoption:
+    """Worker-local adoption for verified admitted-model members."""
+
+    def __init__(self, primitives):
+        self.primitives = primitives
+        self.read_set = None
+        self.assets = None
+        self.namespace = None
+        self.inheritance_cleared = 0
+        self.identities_checked = 0
+        self.observed_identities = []
+        self.materialization_started = False
+        self.status = "new"
+        self.envelope = None
+        self.envelope_sha256 = None
+        self.payload_budget = 0
+
+    def adopt_admitted(self, authenticated_payload, choice, control_value, expected_envelope_sha256, channel_binding=None):
+        _require(self.status == "new" and self.read_set is None, "single_adoption_attempt")
+        self.status = "validating"
+        try:
+            validated_rows = validate_admitted_envelope(
+                authenticated_payload, choice, control_value, expected_envelope_sha256, channel_binding
+            )
+            _require(not any(not handle.closed and handle.value in {row["handle"] for row in validated_rows}
+                             for handle in self.primitives.handles), "inherited_handle_already_owned")
+            read_set = ReadSet()
+            self.read_set = read_set
+            self.primitives.read_sets.append(read_set)
+            # Retain all adopted handles before querying flags or identity.
+            for row in validated_rows:
+                read_set.members.append(self.primitives._retain(row["handle"], "adopted-admitted-member"))
+            ffi = self.primitives.api.ffi
+            for handle in read_set.members:
+                flags = ffi.c_uint32()
+                self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
+                _require(flags.value == 1, "exact_inherited_handle_flag_required")
+                self.primitives.api.checked("SetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), 1, 0)
+                self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
+                _require(flags.value == 0, "inherited_flag_not_cleared")
+                self.inheritance_cleared += 1
+            for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, validated_rows):
+                actual = self.primitives.identity(handle)
+                self.identities_checked += 1
+                self.observed_identities.append(_identity_row(actual))
+                _require(actual == row["identity"], "inherited_file_identity_mismatch")
+                read_set.identities.append(actual)
+            self.assets = tuple(BufferAsset(row["name"], row["size"], row["sha256"], handle)
+                                for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, validated_rows))
+            self.payload_budget = sum(asset.size for asset in self.assets)
+            self.envelope = authenticated_payload
+            self.envelope_sha256 = expected_envelope_sha256
+            self.status = "adopted"
+            return self
+        except BaseException:
+            self.status = "refused"
+            if self.read_set is not None:
+                self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
+            raise
+
+    def materialize_admitted(self):
+        _require(self.status == "adopted" and not self.materialization_started, "adoption_before_readback")
+        self.materialization_started = True
+        # Retain the namespace attempt before reading.
+        self.namespace = PinnedBufferNamespace(self.primitives, self.read_set, self.assets, self.payload_budget)
+        try:
+            self.namespace.materialize()
+            self.status = "materialized"
+            return {
+                "namespace_sha256": self.namespace.namespace_sha256,
+                "payload_bytes": self.payload_budget,
+                "members": [{"name": asset.name, "bytes": asset.size, "sha256": asset.sha256}
+                            for asset in self.assets]
+            }
+        except BaseException:
+            self.status = "refused"
+            self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
+            raise
+
+    def release_unread(self):
+        """Release unread adoption upon early cancel without materializing buffers."""
+        _require(self.status == "adopted" and not self.materialization_started, "unread_cancel_only")
+        if self.read_set is not None:
+            for handle in self.read_set.members:
+                if not handle.closed:
+                    self.primitives._close(handle)
+            self.read_set.released = True
+        self.status = "cancelled"
+        return True
+
+    def release_after_reads(self):
+        _require(self.status == "materialized" and self.read_set is not None and not self.read_set.unconfirmed,
+                 "only_successful_readback_can_release")
+        result = self.primitives.release_read_set(self.read_set)
+        _require(result is True and self.read_set.released, "child_read_guard_release_unconfirmed")
+        self.status = "released"
+        return True
+
+    def receipt(self):
+        return {
+            "status": self.status,
+            "owned_members": len(self.read_set.members) if self.read_set else 0,
+            "inheritance_cleared": self.inheritance_cleared,
+            "identities_checked": self.identities_checked,
+            "observed_identities": list(self.observed_identities),
+            "materialization_started": self.materialization_started,
+            "read_set_unconfirmed": self.read_set.unconfirmed if self.read_set else None,
+            "read_set_released": self.read_set.released if self.read_set else False,
+            "handles_closed": [handle.closed for handle in self.read_set.members] if self.read_set else [],
+            "complete_native_namespace_protection": False,
+            "model_calls": 0,
+        }
+
+
+def expected_admitted_adoption_response(adoption):
+    return {
+        "status": adoption.status,
+        "owned_members": len(adoption.read_set.members),
+        "inheritance_cleared": adoption.inheritance_cleared,
+        "identities_checked": adoption.identities_checked,
+        "materialization_started": adoption.materialization_started,
+    }
